title: Report-processing code for a study of cardiomegaly on early ICU chest radiographs and in-hospital heart-failure diagnoses in critically ill patients with autoimmune rheumatic diseases

creators.name: Wang, Qi
creators.affiliation: Department of Radiology, Huai'an Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, Huai'an, China

creators.name: Wang, Kai
creators.affiliation: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, The Affiliated Huai'an No.1 People's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Huai'an, China

description:
Frozen rule set, examination-type classifier and synthetic test suite used to extract cardiomegaly from the free-text radiology reports of MIMIC-IV-Note, as described in the accompanying manuscript.

The package contains: the frozen text rule (section-aware parsing, a 40-character preceding negation window, a 45-character following resolution window, persistence-phrase removal before the negation search, and severity aggregated to the highest grade in a report); the examination-type classifier that identifies the examination line printed at the head of a report and vetoes non-chest body sites; the 29 hand-written probe reports of Supplementary Table S3 with the label and grade each is expected to return; a driver that applies the rule and reports agreement on label and grade separately; and a blank copy of the form used in the label-blinded review.

Everything runs on Python 3 with the standard library only. No patient data are included and no file requires access to MIMIC-IV: the frozen rules and the synthetic probes reproduce the reported agreement of 1,252/1,252 reports on exposure classification and 240/240 on grade without any credential.
notes: This archive corresponds to tag v1.0.0 of https://github.com/morrosun/ard-icu-cardiomegaly-hf and to Supplementary Code S1 of the manuscript.
